name: Tanglin & Dempsey
summary: Embassy belt calm, dining enclaves, and club-adjacent living near Orchard’s edge.
body:
Tanglin and Dempsey sit in the soft zone between Orchard retail and Botanic Gardens green. Dining clusters at Dempsey, membership clubs nearby, and embassy-adjacent streets give the area a polished, quieter profile. Housing is condo- and landed-heavy; walkability depends on which pocket you land. Strong for families who want central without River Valley density.

Napier station on the Thomson-East Coast Line plus Orchard on the North-South Line cover rail, but Dempsey itself is a drive-or-Grab pocket with limited footpath logic after dark. Rents assume package budgets; sharers and singles usually get more space per dollar one MRT stop out.
housingMix: Upscale condos and landed; limited HDB adjacency.
commuteNotes: Orchard / Napier / Botanic Gardens MRT depending on exact pocket.
